kinds.description: The kinds of results to find. All of them if left out. users finds profiles, and topicPosts finds posts.

resourceKinds.description: The kinds of findings to find: read, watch, and listen. All of them if left out.

view.description: Which findings to find: all, unread, or bookmarked. The last two read the connected account's marks and find findings alone.

tags.description: Topic tags that narrow the results to topics and what belongs to them.

tagMatch.description: How the tags match a topic: any of them, all of them, none of them, or off to ignore them.

sort.description: relevant ranks by how well the name matches, newest by date, and trending by visitors, listeners, and views.

page.description: The page to return, counted from 1.

size.description: How many results a page holds: 5, 10, 25, 50.
